name: Baldwin County Heritage Museum
subtitle: Join Today to Remember Yesterday & Be a Part of Tomorrow!
description: Following a community festival in 1979, a group of citizens who wanted to preserve the farming history of communities in Baldwin County founded BCHM. After opening to the public, we have continued to gain exciting items from local donations. Baldwin County Heritage Museum got non-profit status after locals donated the land. Then, we raised funds, collected items, gathered research, and opened our doors on October 31, 1987. The museum still operates as a 501 (c) (3) non-profit organization with our workforce of volunteers. If you're a history buff looking to find out what life was like for residents of the area years ago, Baldwin County Heritage Museum has a collection of awe-inspiring appliances, farm equipment, and more for you to explore. If you want a glimpse of Baldwin County, AL as it developed, then our heritage museum is the place to go. The mission of the Baldwin County Heritage Museum is to preserve the culture of the farm communities of early Baldwin County through the creation of a home for historically significant buildings, documents, and artifacts from community life. We have collected artifacts and stories from the early farming communities in the area, including tractors, wagons, appliances and clothing. When you walk through our museum, you'll feel like you're stepping back in time. When you have a small group or class of students learning about local farming history, you should schedule a private tour. Our volunteer tour guides can provide a detailed history, answer questions, and guide you through our historic buildings. After enjoying a day of education and history, you can enjoy our beautiful outside picnic space. We also have a collection of historic buildings around Baldwin County that make beautiful venues for weddings and other celebrations.
tagline: Join Today to Remember Yesterday & Be a Part of Tomorrow!

description: Bon Secour National Wildlife Refuge encompasses some of Alabama's last remaining undisturbed coastal barrier habitat. The name Bon Secour comes from the French meaning "safe harbor," very appropriate considering the sanctuary for native flora and fauna the refuge provides. As the surrounding area becomes increasingly developed, Bon Secour is indeed a natural oasis of wildlands, where wildlife can exist without harm. Bon Secour National Wildlife Refuge was established by Congress in 1980 for the protection of neotropical migratory songbird habitat and threatened and endangered species. Bon Secour represents an important stopover and staging habitat for neotropical migratory songbirds during the fall and spring migration along the Alabama coastline. The refuge consists of approximately 7,000 acres of coastal lands, ranging from constantly changing beach dunes to rolling pine-oak woodlands.
tagline: Alabama's last remaining undisturbed coastal barrier habitat - a natural oasis of wildlands

subtitle: The world's preferred destination for convenience and fuel
description: Circle K's success in the convenience retailing industry spans more than 60 years. Our roots trace back to 1951 when Fred Hervey purchased three Kay's Food Stores in El Paso, Texas. Little did anyone know that these stores would serve as the beginning of Circle K. During the early years, Hervey's enterprising spirit enabled the company to make its mark in the southwestern part of the United States. He grew the Circle K chain into neighboring New Mexico and Arizona. During the next few decades, Circle K grew its retail network through a series of acquisitions, which were incorporated into the Circle K brand. By 1975, there were 1,000 Circle K stores across the U.S. In 1979, Circle K entered the international market when a licensing agreement established the first Circle K stores in Japan. The company's growth continued and, by 1984, sales had reached $1 billion. In 1999, a franchise program was introduced to support operators looking to build a business with a leading convenience store brand. In 2003, Circle K was acquired by Alimentation Couche-Tard and has developed into a global brand represented in over 20 countries. Circle K has become one of the most widely recognized convenience store brands, known worldwide for quality products and great customer service. We have come a long way since our humble beginnings, and we're proud of where we've been and where we're going.

Each one is baked in a custom mold for height, texture, and the perfect gooey center. We rotate flavors constantly, treat every customer like family, and keep hospitality at the heart of every store. subtitle: The World Famous Beach Bar - Live Music 365 Days a Year
description: There are many stories about how the most famous beach bar in the country, the Flora-Bama Lounge, became the iconic location it is today. Some of the stories are even true and a few others were thought up on a local bar stool. The truth is that in 1962 the State of Florida gave the State of Alabama two miles of beach front land in return for the construction of the Perdido Pass Bridge. The Tampary family (Father Ted with sons Connie and Tony) decided to build a small bar and package store on the new State Line. The Flora-Bama was originally constructed in 1964, two years after the road was completed. In the early days of the Flora-Bama, the lounge was practically the only thing in the area. As traffic began to increase along the new highway, business grew and the lounge grew to match it with new construction added piecemeal to accommodate the larger crowds. At the time it was established Escambia County, Florida, in which it is located was "wet" while across the line Baldwin County, Alabama, was "dry". The Tamparys created a camaraderie rarely found among people of all ages and walks of life. Joseph Gilchrist purchased the tiny lounge and package store on April 17, 1978, and made live music a daily staple. Joined in 1986, by partner Pat McClellan, together they created calendar events like the "Interstate Mullet Toss" and the "Frank Brown Songwriter's Festival," named after the early, imposing night watchman. In 2009, John McInnis and Cameron Price became co-owners of the Flora-Bama, along with Joe and Pat, to carry it into the next 50 years. Together these four owners have carried on the tradition of making the Country's Best Beach Bar a place where everyone feels comfortable and leaves smiling. Today the live music at the Flora-Bama consist of local favorites to Platinum selling recording artist. The events range from chili cookoffs and fishing rodeos to the Annual Mullet Toss and big beach front concerts. The best part is there is always someone and something different going on at the Flora-Bama every day and you never know who is going to be sitting next to you.
tagline: The World Famous Beach Bar - Live Music 365 Days a Year

At over 4,000 acres, Tarkiln Bayou Preserve is home to four species of endangered pitcher plants as well as other rare and endangered plant species. The carnivorous white-topped pitcher plant is unique to the Gulf Coast and found only between the Apalachicola and Mississippi rivers. Almost 100 other rare plants and animals depend on the wet prairie habitat, including the alligator snapping turtle, sweet pitcher plant and Chapman's butterwort. Visitors can enjoy picnicking and hiking on nature trails to observe rare plants and animals. The system provides opportunities for camping, boating, fishing, wildlife viewing, educational programs, and cultural experiences across diverse ecosystems throughout Florida.

description: At Happy Pappys Coffeehouse, every cup of coffee tells a story – and it's our family's story we're proud to share with you. The Papadelias' have always had an infatuation with coffee. Even the kids, Mallorie and Tony, picked up a taste for coffee at an early age. Prior to opening Happy Pappys, Thomas worked for an insurance company that took him to Texas short-term. When Julie, Mallorie, and Tony were in Texas visiting, the family stumbled upon a coffee shop outside of Dallas and was struck with inspiration. Not only was this a place where you can get high-quality coffee, but a space where you feel at home. The vision for Happy Pappys Coffeehouse was born. After 5 years, Thomas was finally able to move back to Gulf Shores. He and Julie sat down and diligently planned their coffee shop, and asked Mallorie and Tony to contribute to the planning. After 3 years of creating a business plan, searching for the right building, expanding their coffee knowledge, and encapsulating their vision for what the community wanted and needed, Happy Pappys Coffeehouse was born. We opened in August of 2019, surviving both Hurricane Sally and the COVID Pandemic in our first year of business. We are blessed and have proudly served our community since then. We knew we wanted to bring a special place to our community. Everyone needs a physical space beyond home and work—a third place. A place found on one's own that brings a sense of belonging, community, and connection from others. Here at Happy Pappy's Coffeehouse, that's exactly what we aim to do for the community we love! We serve others high quality coffee, a delicious light fare of food and pastries, and most importantly, provide our customers with a genuine love, happiness, and belonging. Our story began with a simple appreciation for good coffee — now, we've turned a passion into a place where friends and family can gather, sip, and create memories. We look forward to serving you soon, Be Happy! Mission: Happy Pappys is a local, family-owned coffee shop with a vision to spread love and happiness throughout the community. Our mission is to provide a premium "third place" where patrons can unwind, socialize, and recharge, all while enjoying high-quality coffee and delicious foods. At Happy Pappys, we are dedicated to creating a welcoming space that brings joy in every visit. Be happy!

description: I have always had a passion for art throughout my life. I would categorize my body of work as Contemporary Impressionism. Along with my journey as a full-time artist, I am a wife & mother to three kids. subtitle: Alabama's highest ranked public golf course combined with luxury beach resort accommodations
description: It was a pretty afternoon at the University of Alabama golf course in Tuscaloosa when undergraduate Jim "Scrappy" Edgemon was playing behind another golfer. Edgemon was standing on a tee 160 yards away waiting for the golfer to complete some precision putting drills on the par-3 16th hole. The distracted golfer finally waved for him to hit up the green, and he did. The green-side golfer recalls thinking, "Man that looks pretty good". It took one hop and started rolling toward the hole, he pulled the pin and it went in for a one. That was his introduction to Scrappy Edgemon. That diligent putter was a young Jerry Pate, a fellow University of Alabama student who went on to win the 1974 U.S. Amateur and the 1976 U.S. Open. Twenty years later, when Edgemon needed an architect to design the golf course at Kiva Dunes, he didn't turn to Fazio, Nicklaus, Dye, or any other top names eager to be associated with the property. He chose Pate. "Jerry Pate has been a winner at everything he's ever done," Edgemon says, "I had seen his work and I knew his passion. I knew when given the best land, he would do the best job. Kiva Dunes is recognized all over the world as one of golf's best and most unique challenges." Pate didn't shy away from the challenge of heading up the design and construction of the course. He knew of the property already, having seen the grounds back in 1985. "I remember thinking at the time, 'Golf architects would kill for this piece of property," Pate says. Today, the Kiva Dunes Golf Course consistently ranks as one of the top courses in the country, and it's all thanks to that one-in-a-million shot and a celebratory handshake between two golf-loving undergrads. Kiva Dunes Resort is located on the Fort Morgan peninsula of Gulf Shores, Alabama. Kiva Dunes presents Alabama's coastal beauty and charm with vacation rentals ranging from beach homes to condos overlooking the 18th green. Each accommodation offers access to the resort's four pools, two restaurants, and over 3,000ft of private beachfront! If golf is your preferred vice, Kiva Dunes Golf Course also provides one of Alabama's highest acclaimed public golf courses – a must-play for golfers of all skill levels, and one of the most dynamic golfing destinations on the Gulf Coast.

description: We are Merchants Bank. Our purpose is to point people forward. We do this by offering financial tools that provide solutions to help our customers go forward, not only financially, but in life. Merchants Bank of Alabama, a division of SouthPoint Bank, has become Cullman County's go-to locally owned bank by going way out of our way. We've helped open local pharmacies and volunteer fire departments, construction companies and manufacturing plants that employ many of our customers. Our Ag Lending has helped keep Cullman County an agricultural powerhouse and family farming a thriving local tradition. And, we have thrived along with our communities. Now, as a division of SouthPoint Bank, we have approximately $1.8 billion in assets and 11 branches. But our greatest asset, our reputation, makes us the go-to bank in the local markets we serve. In a world of mega-banks, The Merchant's Way still towers. As more big-name banks moved into our communities, we kept our commitment to remain a local community bank, which has kept us a local leader. The Merchants Way has never been about size, but about what is big with our customers. Discover the power of banking with a local bank.

Two concrete boat ramps, parking for both vehicles and boat trailers, and restrooms are available for public use. description: Moe's Original BBQ was founded by Mike Fernandez, Ben Gilbert and Jeff Kennedy. After meeting at the University of Alabama, they instantly became friends and had a mutual interest in all things Southern: BBQ, blues, college football, and whiskey. In 1988, Mike learned to fire roast meats from Tuscaloosa legend Moses Day, whose distinct style makes up Moe's original flavor of BBQ. Eventually the founding partners all relocated to Vail, CO, where each refined their cooking skills. Together, they created something special by using fruit wood to smoke their meats and complementing them with two sauces. A trip to Moe's Original BBQ means a chance to slow down, make connections and enjoy our quality recipes passed down for generations. When you dine at Moe's, you're always the guest. The Moe's Original team takes pride in ensuring that their customers enjoy themselves as much as their meal. Expect to be served top notch BBQ, soulful sides and a beer or bushwacker complemented by a smile and thank you. Today, Moe's Original BBQ has been named in the Top 10 BBQ Chains in America by USA Today and The Daily Meal, one of the fastest growing, emerging restaurant chains by Restaurant Business Magazine, and one of the Top 10 Rib Joints in the U.S. by Relish. The Orange Beach location, in the mid-2000s, was partnered with Mark "Pinto" White to test the BBQ waters of Alabama and it turned out to be a success. Since then, partners Lee Nelson and Matt Lovato joined Mark to keep the beach BBQ joint running smoothly. After an extensive fire in 2020, an Ole Hickory smoking pit was added along with more square footage to make the dining room, bathrooms and kitchen larger. There is now seating for 110, inside and outdoors. Additionally, salads, bushwackers and liquor drinks are available. Guests dining in now receive buzzers while waiting for their orders. Take out customers are texted when orders are ready and can grab them quickly from a designated pick up window. We also feature live music in the backyard when weather permits.
